title: pancashloki — pan-p01
question: Whatever I have truly done, O Lord — no duty of mine goes beyond this: my pride has been offered by me with devotion on the Lord's lotus feet. This is my all; I know there is nothing other than this. Therefore, having cast all else aside — quickly, O protector of the helpless, O ocean of compassion — be pleased!
